entries.category_description: Transport of passengers and their accompanying luggage
entries.comment: Other transport of passengers as well as their accompanying unchecked luggage and animals - Royal Decree N° 20, Table A, category XXV

entries.category_description: Transport of passengers and their accompanying luggage
entries.comment:
Taxis, scheduled busses, trains and air transport are exempted. In connection with international transportation of passengers the exemption also covers accompanying luggage.
Passenger transport in tourist busses and similar vehicles (CPA 49.39.32, 49.39.33, 49.39.34) are subject to VAT in Denmark (Standard rate).

entries.category_description: Transport of passengers and their accompanying luggage
entries.comment: Domestic transport. In class 96.03.12 only carriage of corpses included.

entries.category_description: Transport of passengers and their accompanying luggage
entries.comment:
Passenger transport services provided by means of transport entitled to execute sea, lake, river and lagoon transport services.
Urban passenger transport service by water with the exception of transport for tourism, cruises and exempt transport.

entries.category_description: Transport of passengers and their accompanying luggage
entries.comment: Tabel I prov. b.9: private bus transport; public transport and taxi transport as referred to in Article 1 of the 'Wet personenvervoer 2000 (Dutch 'Passenger Transport Act 2000'), taxi transport of persons by road other than by car, and the transport of persons by aircraft if the place of departure and the place of destination are located in the Netherlands insofar as this transport takes place by balloons or by aircraft equipped for the transport of ill or injured persons;

entries.category_description: Transport of passengers and their accompanying luggage
entries.comment: International transport of passengers is subject to a zero rate.

entries.category_description: Transport of passengers and their accompanying luggage
entries.comment: Domestic transports of passengers are subject to the reduced rate, please see chapter 9 section 8 in the Swedish VAT Act (https://www.riksdagen.se/sv/dokument-lagar/dokument/svensk-forfattningssamling/mervardesskattelag-2023200_sfs-2023-200#K9). International transports of passengers are exempted.
